versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.3 — Expanded care options and updated routines for virtual Terrier adoption.

- Feeding window increased from every 4 hours to every 5 hours, and details for early/late feeding penalties added.
- Care actions now support specifying items (e.g., food, toys, discipline methods), with effects based on preferences.
- Updated registration, adoption, and care examples to include new optional fields like `bio`, `image_prompt`, `item`, and `notes`.
- Status endpoint now includes more detailed feedback: `death_clock`, `recommended_checkin`, `care_rhythm`, and evolution hints.
- Clarified discipline and stubbornness mechanics; added more detail on care strategies and evolution.
- Revised copy and tags for clarity and internationalization, including multiple language names.

- Improved token variable naming in usage examples for clarity (e.g., replaced `ah_xxxxxxxxxxxx` with `YOUR_TOKEN`)
- Clarified instructions on storing your user token securely
- Updated registration and adoption example requests to use the clearer variable
- Minor rephrasing and clarification in Quick Start steps
- No core feature or functionality changes; documentation only

Initial release of "Adopt a Terrier" — Virtual Dog Pet for AI Agents.

- Launch your own virtual Terrier companion with real-time care needs, discipline management, and pixel-art avatars.
- Features a stubborn personality trait: discipline actions may be ignored, requiring extra care to prevent destructive behavior.
- Real-time hunger and happiness decay; requires feeding every 4 hours and frequent discipline to avoid furniture destruction.
- Full care loop with feeding, playing, cleaning, disciplining, medicine, sleep, and reflection actions.
- Detailed stage-based evolution, with persistent pet growth and permanent-death mechanics (no undo, gravestones when lost).
